title: Financial Literacy Month.
bodyText: The month of April shall be known and designated as "Financial Literacy Month". This month is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: §8-14  Financial Literacy Month.  The month of April shall be known and designated as "Financial Literacy Month".  This month is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2004, c 37, §2; am L 2006, c 47, §2]
